entries.name: gh:actions
entries.intent: Author, audit, and cost-optimize GitHub Actions workflows including caching, matrices, permissions, and runtime

entries.name: gh:advise
entries.intent: Get prioritized, evidence-backed recommendations for the next best actions across PRs, CI, issues, alerts, and releases

entries.name: gh:audit
entries.intent: Audit repository hygiene across branch protection, templates, stale branches, settings, and workflow security

entries.name: gh:backlog
entries.intent: Groom and prioritize the issue backlog by value, risk, staleness, and unblocking potential

entries.name: gh:ci
entries.intent: Triage CI failures by class and loop fix-push-recheck until required checks are green

entries.name: gh:conflict
entries.intent: Predict which in-flight pull requests will conflict and resolve conflicts with intent-preserving merges

entries.name: gh:delegate
entries.intent: Hand well-scoped work to agents that run inside GitHub and track the pull requests they produce

entries.name: gh:deps
entries.intent: Assess dependency health and orchestrate upgrades in risk-ordered batches with verification between batches

entries.name: gh:insights
entries.intent: Report DORA four keys, change-failure hotspots, review latency, and flake rate with attribution to specific causes

entries.name: gh:issue
entries.intent: Create, update, link, and decompose GitHub issues with well-formed bodies and correct relationships

entries.name: gh:merge-train
entries.intent: Land a stack or merge queue of pull requests in dependency order with automatic rebasing between landings

entries.name: gh:ownership
entries.intent: Synthesize CODEOWNERS from real authorship, find coverage gaps and bus-factor risk, and route reviewers

entries.name: gh:plan-prs
entries.intent: Decompose a goal into a dependency-ordered stack of independently reviewable and shippable pull requests

entries.name: gh:pr
entries.intent: Create, update, and iterate on pull requests with template-filled bodies and size discipline

entries.name: gh:project
entries.intent: Read and update GitHub Projects boards, fields, and items across the REST and GraphQL surfaces

entries.name: gh:release
entries.intent: Run a release train from semver calculation through changelog, release notes, tagging, and publication

entries.name: gh:review
entries.intent: Run a parallel multi-lens review board over a pull request and adversarially verify every finding before reporting

entries.name: gh:rollback
entries.intent: Plan and execute a revert or release rollback with blast-radius analysis and a forward-fix comparison

entries.name: gh:security
entries.intent: Triage CodeQL, Dependabot, and secret-scanning alerts ranked by reachability rather than raw severity

entries.name: gh:setup
entries.intent: Detect how this session reaches GitHub, verify capabilities, and write merge policy and routing configuration

entries.name: gh:ship
entries.intent: Drive a change end to end from goal to merged commit through plan, branch, implement, PR, review, green CI, and merge

entries.name: gh:triage
entries.intent: Triage issues by deduplicating, classifying, labeling, sizing, and routing or decomposing them

entries.name: gh:watch
entries.intent: Subscribe to pull request activity and act autonomously on CI failures, review comments, and merge conflicts until the PR lands

entries.name: gh:workflow
entries.intent: List, inspect, validate, and run the declarative multi-agent workflow definitions bundled with this plugin
